originalTitle: Did The Market Read AppLovin Stock Right?

content:

AppLovin (APP) stock lost 59.6% in the year to October 29, 2026, while the S&P 500 returned 13.3%. The shares suffered their two worst days on February 12 and August 6, 2026, falling each time the day after the company reported a quarter, yet both reports showed sales growing by more than half from a year earlier. Two other heavy falls, 16.9% on January 30 and 16.1% on February 4, came as news said AI products from Google and CloudX could threaten its business. The market was right that sales growth is slowing, but AppLovin’s profit has kept rising.

Both AppLovin Reports Sent The Shares Sharply Lower

The shares fell 19.7% on each of the days after the two reports, though only the August report clearly missed sales estimates. AppLovin’s fourth-quarter 2025 sales, reported on February 11, 2026, topped most analysts’ estimates, and several outlets tied the February 12 fall to fears about AI rivals.

On August 5, 2026, management said second-quarter revenue of almost $2 billion landed just below the midpoint of its own guidance. The company also said adjusted EBITDA, its own measure of operating profit, came in just below the guided range. Management said the performance fell short of the standard it sets for itself.

Management attributed the shortfall to timing. Gaming remains most of AppLovin’s revenue and grows when the company’s ad models improve. Those models improved less than usual in the quarter, with the next step up landing just after the period ended. Management also said it saw nothing suggesting weaker advertiser demand.

AppLovin Buyers Pay Far Less Per Dollar Of Profit

At the end of September 2025, AppLovin stock traded at 100.1 times its profit over the previous four quarters . At the October 29, 2026 close, it traded at 19.4 times, sitting below the 22.8 for the S&P 500.

Meanwhile, AppLovin’s sales growth slowed in each of the last four quarters , sliding from 77.0% in the second quarter of 2025 to 52.8% a year later. Management guided to 46% to 48% growth for the third quarter of 2026, lower again.

So the year changed what buyers will pay for AppLovin’s profit. With the stock now priced below the market on that measure, the price appears to assume that growth keeps slowing.

A stock’s multiple is the market’s bet on where growth goes next. The clearest recent example is Tesla, still priced at about 13 times sales after its deliveries fell two years in a row before a partial rebound this year. Read Trefis Big Story : How Tesla Blundered .

AppLovin Still Earns More Every Quarter

AppLovin’s net income rose in each of the last four quarters, even as the shares fell. It came to $4.41 billion over the four quarters to June 2026, compared with $2.43 billion a year earlier.

The company also carries little debt for its size. Its total debt equals 4.1% of its market value, against 19.4% for the S&P 500.

That rising profit is the part of AppLovin the fall in the stock has not touched. Quarterly net income, which reached $1.27 billion in the second quarter of 2026, is the number to watch when the company reports again in November 2026.

Does This Mean You Should Act On APP?

Our purpose is to inform you with unique data so you can make the right investment decisions. That said, betting on a single stock is always risky, no matter which direction you choose.

There is a smarter approach. chineseTitle: 市场对 AppLovin 股票的解读正确吗？

截至 2026 年 10 月 29 日的一年里，AppLovin (APP) 股票下跌了 59.6%，而标准普尔 500 指数则上涨了 13.3%。该股在 2026 年 2 月 12 日和 8 月 6 日经历了最糟糕的两个交易日，每次都在该公司公布季度报告后的第二天下跌，但两份报告均显示销售额较上年同期增长了一半以上。另外两次大幅下跌，即 1 月 30 日下跌 16.9% 和 2 月 4 日下跌 16.1%，有消息称谷歌和 CloudX 的人工智能产品可能威胁其业务。市场认为销售增长正在放缓是正确的，但 AppLovin 的利润却一直在增长。

AppLovin 的两份报告均导致股价大幅下跌

两份报告发布后，该股连续几天下跌 19.7%，但只有 8 月份的报告明显低于销售预期。 AppLovin 于 2026 年 2 月 11 日公布的 2025 年第四季度销售额超出了大多数分析师的预期，多家媒体将 2 月 12 日的销售额下降与对人工智能竞争对手的担忧联系在一起。

2026 年 8 月 5 日，管理层表示，第二季度收入近 20 亿美元，略低于其指导目标的中点。该公司还表示，调整后的 EBITDA（其自身衡量营业利润的指标）略低于指导范围。管理层表示，业绩未达到其为自己设定的标准。

管理层将这一不足归因于时机。游戏仍然是 AppLovin 的大部分收入，并且随着公司广告模式的改进而增长。这些模型在本季度的改善程度低于平常，下一阶段的改善是在该季度结束后发生的。管理层还表示，没有发现任何迹象表明广告商需求减弱。

AppLovin 买家为每美元利润支付的费用要低得多

截至 2025 年 9 月末，AppLovin 股票交易价格是前四个季度利润的 100.1 倍。截至 2026 年 10 月 29 日收盘，其交易价格为 19.4 倍，低于标准普尔 500 指数的 22.8 倍。

与此同时，AppLovin 的销售增长在过去四个季度中每个季度都在放缓，从 2025 年第二季度的 77.0% 下滑至一年后的 52.8%。管理层预计 2026 年第三季度增长 46% 至 48%，再次下调。

因此，这一年改变了买家为 AppLovin 利润支付的费用。鉴于该股目前的定价低于市场水平，该价格似乎假设增长持续放缓。

股票的市盈率是市场对下一步增长方向的押注。最近最明显的例子是特斯拉，其交付量连续两年下降，但今年有所反弹，但其定价仍约为销量的 13 倍。阅读 Trefis 大故事：特斯拉如何犯错。

AppLovin 每个季度的收入仍然更高

尽管股价下跌，但 AppLovin 的净利润在过去四个季度中每个季度都在增长。截至 2026 年 6 月的四个季度，该数字达到 44.1 亿美元，而去年同期为 24.3 亿美元。

就其规模而言，该公司的债务也很少。其总债务相当于其市值的 4.1%，而标准普尔 500 指数的这一比例为 19.4%。

利润的上升是 AppLovin 股票下跌未触及的部分。该公司 2026 年 11 月再次发布财报时，值得关注的数字是 2026 年第二季度的季度净利润达到 12.7 亿美元。
